stages.name: Onboarding
stages.welcome:
Welcome to Stage 1: Gold Loan Onboarding.
Please enter customer's 10-digit mobile number

stages.name: Identity Verification
stages.welcome: Welcome to Stage 2: Identity Verification Please upload Aadhaar and PAN images.

stages.name: Profile Details
stages.welcome: Welcome to Stage 3: Profile Details Confirm address from Aadhaar, or override with proof upload.

stages.name: Gold Valuation
stages.welcome:
Welcome to Stage 4: Gold Valuation.
Please upload BOTH:
- a clear photo of the ornament on the weighing scale, AND
- the purchase bill OR valuation certificate.

stages.name: Offer Selection
stages.welcome: Welcome to Stage 5: Offer Selection. Offers will be loaded.

stages.name: Closing and Disbursal
stages.welcome: Welcome to Stage 6: Closing and Disbursal. Has the Personal Discussion (PD) checklist been completed with the customer?

_comment: Stage entry is triggered by the human's next message once the previous stage is done (its agent asks whether to continue); there are no on-screen buttons, and a reply that stops the application never advances. Stage 1 starts on the first message (a greeting). Tool sets come from tools.json (`stage` field).
